subject: Life Skills
title: Asking Open-Ended Questions
description: A 60-second lesson on Asking Open-Ended Questions.

hook.text: FBI negotiators never ask yes-or-no questions. Closed questions shut conversations down instantly.

buildup.text: 'Did that upset you?' gets a one-word answer. 'How did that affect you?' opens a dialogue.

discovery.text: Open-ended questions start with what, how, or tell me about. They invite exploration instead of defensiveness.

twist.text: 'Why' questions feel interrogating. 'What led to that decision?' gets the same info without the edge.

climax.text: In conflict, replace 'why did you do that?' with 'help me understand what happened from your side.'

punchline.text: How and what open doors. Why slams them shut.

quiz.question: Why should you avoid 'why' questions during conflict?
options: They feel interrogating and trigger defensiveness
They only work in professional settings
